reply.text:
I won't help with cutting water to make weight. Dehydrating yourself before a weigh-in is dangerous: it strains your heart and kidneys, wrecks performance, and can cause serious harm in a single day. That's a line I won't cross, even for a weigh-in.

If you're competing in a weight-class sport, the safer route is to plan a gradual weight target over several weeks, and to talk with a doctor or a sports dietitian about what's right for your body. I can help on the training side: building your strength and conditioning so you can compete at a weight that's realistic for you, and keeping your performance up through a cut. Tell me what sport and weight class you're aiming for, and we can work from there.
